title: [VIC] Stanley 16oz Claw Hammer $4 (in-store only) @ Bunnings, Springvale
body:
Deal: [VIC] Stanley 16oz Claw Hammer $4 (in-store only) @ Bunnings, Springvale

[Nominal] Once upon a time I was led to believe that yellow tickets are store specific discounts and orange tickets are nationwide, but that might just be urban legend?
[pdtmathieson] I think some clearance (yellow) is everywhere, such as a related line, some are store specific, such as an overstock
[eddyah] Finally a cheap alternative for machetes
[SolidEther] Thanks, just bought 8 of them! great deal.
[nosytt] Great for home defense for when you know who come knocking
[zerokas] Got a bunch in Kirrawee a few days ago for $ 8 ea. The guy at the counter said they came in as deleted items so they just put a random price on them. Very nice hammers with good grip.
[jace88] Can't find it online so for others, YMMV. BAsed on this and it not listed on website, appears to be in-store only then.
[Chazzozz] Can’t touch this!
(Out of stock in my local Bunnings)
[chinaman] The springvale counter machete tool of choice! Team Hammer
